name: acceptance
description: Negotiate Gherkin acceptance criteria before any code, open the ticket in your tracker (YouTrack or Azure DevOps) and name the branch after it, then collect every proof — captures, videos, cURL, test runs, artifacts — into the ticket. Rules, proofs and the ticket are published as three artifacts per ticket, linked from a band above the prompt, and any later session recovers them from the branch name. A team can also commit its own ticket workflow (.claude/acceptance-workflow.json): take the ticket, one sub-task per person and module, estimates, measured time, PR and comment templates, hand-over — enforced by gates on edits, commits and pull requests, created with /acceptance-workflow, and read back with /acceptance-journal.

token.title: Tracker token
token.description: A YouTrack permanent token or an Azure DevOps personal access token (Work Items read & write), written as "<tracker url> <token>" to bind it to that tracker; several pairs separated by ;. Leave empty to use the ACCEPTANCE_TRACKER_TOKEN environment variable, then the file ~/.config/acceptance/token (one line per tracker, recommended locally: every surface reads it).
